No. Starter and Growth absorb the repetitive missed-call and follow-up work. The AI Receptionist plan answers the calls your team cannot take and hands anything sensitive, complex or urgent to a person. It is built to cover the calls that would otherwise go unanswered, not to remove your staff.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.metaDescription: How TradeCatch collects, uses, and protects information submitted through this website and the systems we manage.

sections.heading: Who this policy covers
sections.body: This policy applies to TradeCatch, operated by Ara Ghahramanyan from the Greater Montreal area, Quebec, Canada, with respect to personal information collected through this website and the systems we manage on behalf of contractor clients. It is written to reflect Quebec's private-sector privacy legislation (the Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector, as amended by Law 25) and applicable federal privacy law (PIPEDA).

sections.heading: Information we collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly when you request an audit: name, company, trade, email, phone number, city, and qualification answers. When a pilot is activated, we may also process, within the agreed scope, names, phone numbers, addresses, service-request details and photos; call and text content and metadata; technician contact information; and quotes, appointments, pipeline stages, reported values, review requests, and workspace events. We also collect technical data and, with your consent, analytics data as explained in our Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: Purposes and legal basis for collection
sections.body: We use this information to respond to audit requests, schedule calls, prepare proposals and, within an agreed pilot, respond to missed calls, collect and route requests, run follow-ups, manage bookings, populate the linked workspace, and send configured events. The applicable basis depends on context, including consent, pre-contractual steps, the service agreement, and legal obligations. We do not sell personal information.

sections.heading: SMS and email communication consent
sections.body: Contacting you about your specific audit request (by phone, email, or text) is a necessary service communication, not optional marketing. It is covered by the required consent checkbox on our forms. Marketing emails (tips, offers, updates) are separate, optional, opt-in, and never pre-checked, consistent with Canada's Anti-Spam Legislation (CASL). Message and data rates may apply to SMS. We record the exact wording, source form, and timestamp of each consent given, and honour opt-out or unsubscribe requests without delay.

sections.heading: Data sharing and service providers
sections.body: We share information with service providers that support our operations under agreements requiring them to protect your data and use it only for the purpose we specify. As of this writing that includes: Resend (transactional email delivery), Google Analytics 4 (site analytics, only after cookie consent), Cloudflare (website hosting and delivery, including Turnstile bot-abuse prevention on our forms), and Twilio (SMS/voice for missed-call recovery when enabled). We do not share your information for third-party advertising.

sections.heading: Cross-border data transfers
sections.body: Some service providers may process or store personal information outside Quebec or Canada, including in the United States. Before a provider processes personal information outside Quebec, we assess the privacy factors required by law and determine the appropriate contractual or other safeguards. Processing locations and applicable measures are described in client documentation or agreements when required.

sections.heading: Data retention schedule
sections.body: We target retention of up to 24 months after the last interaction for audit requests and missed-call operational records, unless the law, an earlier deletion request, or a client agreement requires otherwise. Automated purging for those categories depends on durable storage and the scheduled task; until deployment is verified, it is performed manually. Other pilot data—website leads, quotes, bookings, pipeline records, review requests, and related logs—follows the retention term in the client agreement and is deleted manually until full lifecycle automation is in place. Analytics data follows Google Analytics' retention settings.

sections.heading: Your privacy rights
sections.body: Under Quebec and Canadian privacy law you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, and may withdraw consent to non-essential processing at any time, by contacting our privacy contact below. We will respond within the timelines required by law.

sections.heading: How to reach us or file a complaint
sections.body: For any privacy question or request, contact our privacy contact at contact@tradecatch.ca. If you believe we have not resolved your concern, you may file a complaint with the Commission d'accès à l'information du Québec (CAI).

sections.heading: Security and incident reporting
sections.body: We apply technical and organizational safeguards (encryption in transit, access restrictions, security headers, and the controls described in our security practices) appropriate to the sensitivity of the information involved. In the event of a confidentiality incident presenting a risk of serious harm, we will notify affected individuals and the CAI as required by Law 25.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy as our practices or legal obligations change. Material changes will be reflected in the "last updated" date above.

termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.metaDescription: The terms governing the use of the TradeCatch website and the revenue recovery systems we design, install, and manage.

sections.heading: Services
sections.body: TradeCatch designs, installs, and manages automated communication workflows for contractor businesses. Capabilities are offered only in a founder-led controlled pilot and when explicitly included in a written proposal. Missed-call recovery is the core pilot path; website capture and quote follow-up are linked Starter pilot modules; booking, reminders, pipeline, attribution, reviews, and the activity timeline require an entitled, linked Growth organization. AI call answering, qualification and booking by phone, human call transfer, emergency call routing, and call summaries are part of the AI Receptionist plan and are configured per business during onboarding; AI calling usage is subject to the allowance and limits set out in the written proposal. Native Google/Outlook calendar sync and native two-way CRM sync are not included and remain planned. Nothing in these terms represents a self-serve SaaS launch or a production-readiness guarantee.

sections.heading: Client responsibilities
sections.body: Clients are responsible for providing accurate business information, approving message content and escalation rules before launch, and ensuring that licensed staff handle diagnosis, pricing, and safety-related decisions.

sections.heading: Service limitations
sections.body: The system does not diagnose technical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, medical, or safety conditions, and does not guarantee any specific volume of leads, bookings, or revenue. Results depend on factors outside our control, including demand, pricing, and service quality.

sections.heading: Emergency handling
sections.body: The system escalates messages using rules the client approves in advance; it does not itself assess or respond to emergencies. Handling of urgent or safety-related situations remains the responsibility of the contractor and their qualified personnel at all times, and clients must maintain their own emergency-response process independent of this system.

sections.heading: Fees and payment
sections.body: Setup and monthly management fees are outlined in your proposal and invoiced according to the agreed schedule. Late payment may result in suspension of services.

sections.heading: Cancellation and refunds
sections.body: Either party may terminate the management agreement with written notice according to the term specified in your proposal. Setup fees are non-refundable once work has begun; unused prepaid management fees for the remainder of a notice period are not refunded except as required by applicable Quebec consumer-protection law.

sections.heading: Electronic acceptance
sections.body: Proposals, this agreement, and related documents may be accepted electronically (including by e-signature or by written confirmation such as email). Electronic acceptance has the same legal effect as a handwritten signature, consistent with Quebec's legal framework for information technology (An Act to establish a legal framework for information technology).

sections.heading: Limitation of liability
sections.body: TradeCatch is not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of the system, including missed communications caused by third-party phone, SMS, or software providers.

sections.heading: Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Province of Quebec and the applicable federal laws of Canada.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.metaDescription: Which cookies this website uses, why, and how to manage your preferences.

sections.heading: What are cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that help websites function and let us understand how visitors use the site. This site also uses similar browser storage (localStorage) to remember your cookie choice itself.

sections.heading: Cookies and storage we use
sections.body: Essential: a language-preference cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) remembers whether you're browsing in French or English; none of our own session cookies are otherwise strictly required for core browsing, and your cookie-consent choice is saved in your browser's localStorage so we don't ask again every visit. Analytics: Google Analytics 4 sets cookies (such as _ga) to measure traffic and usage, and only loads after you accept analytics cookies below. Security: Cloudflare Turnstile may set short-lived, essential cookies while verifying that a form submission is not automated; these are not used for tracking. We do not use cookies for third-party advertising.

sections.heading: Managing your cookie choice
sections.body: You can accept all cookies, reject non-essential cookies, or open detailed preferences using the banner shown on your first visit. All three options are equally easy to choose. You can change your choice at any time using the "Manage cookies" link in the footer, or by changing your browser settings to block or delete cookies.

acceptableUsePolicy.title: Acceptable Use Policy
acceptableUsePolicy.metaDescription: Rules for acceptable use of the TradeCatch website, forms, and related systems.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: This policy sets out acceptable use of this website, its forms, and any system we operate on your behalf. It exists to keep the site and our systems safe, available, and usable for everyone.

sections.heading: Prohibited activity
sections.body: You may not use this website or its forms to: submit false, fraudulent, or malicious information; attempt to bypass security controls (including rate limits, bot-verification, or form validation); scrape, harvest, or bulk-extract content or contact data; upload or transmit malicious code; or use the site in a way that infringes another party's rights or violates applicable law.

sections.heading: Automated and bulk use
sections.body: Automated interaction with our forms or systems (bots, scripts, scrapers) is not permitted except for legitimate, publicly documented purposes (such as search-engine indexing of public pages) that respect our robots.txt directives.

sections.heading: Enforcement
sections.body: We may block, rate-limit, or refuse service to any user or system that violates this policy, and may report unlawful activity to the appropriate authorities.

accessibilityStatement.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibilityStatement.metaDescription: Our accessibility target for this website, known limitations, and how to report an accessibility issue.

sections.heading: Our commitment
sections.body: We aim to provide a website that is accessible to the widest possible audience and are working toward conformance with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2 at Level AA. WCAG is a technical standard, not a legal designation — we treat conformance with it as our working benchmark rather than a claim of legal compliance in any particular jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Accessibility features implemented
sections.body: Semantic landmarks and heading structure on every page; a skip-to-main-content link; full keyboard operability for the navigation, mobile menu, forms, and the audit-booking wizard, including a focus trap and Escape-to-close in the mobile menu and returning focus to the trigger on close; visible focus indicators on all interactive elements; support for the prefers-reduced-motion setting; form fields with programmatic labels, required-state and error messaging that is announced to assistive technology and linked to the relevant field; and alt text on informative images with decorative graphics hidden from assistive technology.

sections.heading: Known limitations
sections.body: This site is under active development. Some third-party embeds, such as the Cloudflare Turnstile widget or any separately added external calendar-provider embed, are provided by external vendors and may not fully match our own accessibility standard. No native Google/Outlook calendar sync is included in the current pilot. Automated and manual testing cannot catch every barrier — we review and address issues as they're identified rather than treating any point-in-time audit as a guarantee of full conformance.

sections.heading: Standards and legal compliance
sections.body: TradeCatch is based in Québec and primarily serves contractors in Québec; we may also serve clients elsewhere in Canada and in the United States. Accessibility legal obligations vary by jurisdiction (for example, Québec's rules under the Act to secure handicapped persons in the exercise of their rights, and — where applicable to U.S. visitors — the Americans with Disabilities Act) and can differ from the WCAG technical standard described above. We do not claim certified legal compliance with any specific accessibility law, and we recommend anyone with a specific legal question consult qualified counsel in the relevant jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Feedback, alternate formats, and contact
sections.body: If you encounter an accessibility barrier on this site, or need information from this site in another format, please contact us at contact@tradecatch.ca describing the page and the issue (or the format you need). We will work to address genuine barriers and respond to format requests in a reasonable timeframe.

sections.heading: Date of this statement
sections.body: This statement was last reviewed on August 15, 2026, alongside a review of the site's HTML structure, keyboard behaviour, forms, and colour contrast.

demoVideo.transcript: You already paid to make the phone ring. But when you are working, you cannot always answer. In a controlled pilot, TradeCatch texts back within seconds, under your company's name. The customer stays engaged instead of calling your competitor. It collects the customer's name, problem, urgency, address, and a photo while you stay on the job. When you check your phone, the lead is already qualified. The right technician receives one clear job summary. They can accept, decline, or call; a backup can be alerted if no one responds. Acceptance notifies the customer. Entitled, linked Growth pilot organizations book in-app—without native Google or Outlook sync. Starter pilots can follow up on quotes on days 1, 3, 7, and 14. A reply stops the sequence; the pipeline is only for entitled, linked Growth pilot organizations. Figures are illustrative, not promised results. Workspaces show linked-organization data only—not self-serve SaaS or native two-way CRM. Stop losing jobs when you cannot answer. Get your free missed-opportunity audit with TradeCatch.
